fail_closed_policy: Any rule absent from this exact registry, with an unknown scope value, or with an identity/version mismatch is excluded from RJSC score, risk band, rescue, score hash inputs and release eligibility. Out-of-scope is not NOT_APPLICABLE and does not imply legal exemption.
separation_of_concerns: Scope classification determines whether a rule may participate in RJSC assessment. It does not verify statutory accuracy, applicability, evidence sufficiency, legal status, or counsel approval.
